scope: Ontology-authoritative 79-predicate world-truth evaluator over six scope classes.
transition_rule: Emit delta only when the four-valued state changes at adjacent five-tick authoritative samples; boolean rising/falling transitions remain the L2 event trigger surface.

parameter_governance.note: Every threshold is bounded by an explicit simulation-domain model; values are not real-world certification claims.

boundary_margin_m.resolution: single_global_authority; any scenario declaration must equal the governed value

boundary_response_distance_m.resolution: single_global_authority; a scenario that declares parameters.boundary_response_distance_m must equal the governed value and its boundary_conflict trigger distance, and must carry basis and scope

boundary_margin_m.model: scenario conflict envelope; in-band horizontal bound d_margin=v*t_reaction+v^2/(2*a_deceleration), with Euclidean vertical clearance outside the restricted prism

boundary_response_distance_m.model: L1-1 boundary-conflict response trigger radius: the authored reaction point stays inside the governed conflict envelope, so it may not exceed boundary_margin_m; the episode's boundary crossing and response horizon are measured against this radius

low_illumination_threshold_lux.model: maximum log-margin separator between the formal low-light profile (80 lux) and the nearest non-low-light profile (1800 lux); sqrt(80*1800)=379.47 lux, rounded to the governed 400-lux boundary

safety.forced_landing_in_populated_area.closure_statement: No L0 producer materializes a real, typed PopulatedArea individual; pedestrian or vehicle identifiers must not be relabeled as areas.

security.unauthorized_command_received.closure_statement: Command-source validity is state evidence only; no L0 producer materializes a typed UnauthorizedCommand individual.

security.security_control_unavailable.closure_statement: Lockout state is not a CyberSecurityControl individual, and no L0 producer materializes that required participant.

security.control_command_integrity_viola.closure_statement: Command-integrity state is not a CommandStream individual, and no L0 producer materializes that required participant.

emergency.evacuation_in_progress.closure_statement: Crowd evacuation state exists, but no L0 producer materializes a real, typed EvacuationRoute participant.

emergency.emergency_vehicle_priority_act.closure_statement: Typed ambulance and right-of-way state do not materialize the required AmbulancePriorityPassage or EmergencyResponse lifecycle individual.

regulation.vehicle_violates_right_of_way.closure_statement: SUMO materializes typed RightOfWay identities for controlled connections, but no scenario or physical producer materializes a nominal or violation state for a bound vehicle and RightOfWay tuple.
